findings.message: ADD COLUMN rewrites users under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE (table rewrite: volatile default evaluated per row); add the column nullable, backfill in batches, then constrain it
findings.detail: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users, held for a table rewrite; blocks reads and writes
findings.fix:
-- +mig step: add_users_token_nullable
-- the column arrives nullable and empty: catalog only, no rewrite
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN token uuid;

-- +mig step: set_users_token_default
-- future rows get the default; existing rows are left to the backfill
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN token SET DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

-- +mig step: backfill_users_token
-- +mig backfill: table=users key=id batch=5000
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE token IS NULL))
-- batched so each transaction stays short; key=id is assumed, point it at the primary key if that is not right
UPDATE users SET token = gen_random_uuid() WHERE id > :cursor_lo AND id <= :cursor_hi AND token IS NULL;

-- +mig step: users_token_not_null_check
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('users') AND conname = 'users_token_nn') OR coalesce((SELECT attnotnull FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('users') AND attname = 'token'), false))
-- NOT VALID: the check exists without scanning anything
ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_token_nn CHECK (token IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;

-- +mig step: validate_users_token_not_null
-- +mig notx
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('users') AND conname = 'users_token_nn' AND convalidated) OR coalesce((SELECT attnotnull FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('users') AND attname = 'token'), false))
-- the scan happens here, without blocking reads or writes
ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT users_token_nn;

-- +mig step: set_users_token_not_null
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT coalesce((SELECT attnotnull FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('users') AND attname = 'token'), false))
-- catalog only from Postgres 12: the validated check is the proof
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN token SET NOT NULL;

-- +mig step: drop_users_token_check
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('users') AND conname = 'users_token_nn'))
-- the column carries NOT NULL itself now; the scaffolding leaves
ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT users_token_nn;
